Regional Football Pathways | Preparation guidance reviewed 18 October 2026
Recommended template, not a universal club requirement. Follow the receiving club’s instructions.
Replace bracketed text; delete irrelevant fields. Do not send this uncompleted template.

SUBJECT: [Boys’/girls’ pathway] assessment enquiry — [age], [position], Australia

Hello [club / academy team],

I am [the parent/guardian of / an adult player aged] [age]. [Player name / I] currently plays for [club, team and exact competition] in [town], Queensland, Australia, primarily as a [position].

Do you consider Australian-based players in this age group for assessment? We are exploring [proposed dates], subject to confirmation.

Citizenship already held: [details]. Usual residence: [country]. Existing UK immigration status: [if known]. Pending citizenship application, if relevant: [state separately].

Please advise the appropriate application route and any residence, age or registration restrictions. Your published requirements mention [relevant items]. [Include CV/video links only where invited; otherwise ask what to send.]

If assessment is possible, could you confirm the process, safeguarding arrangements and costs or expenses before travel is arranged?

Thank you,
[Parent/guardian name for under-18 / adult player name]
[Email and phone with country code]

Before sending: check correct pathway, source date, recipient, access to links and all placeholders. Follow the club's response policy. No reply is not an invitation. This website does not send emails.
